description:
You are an AV equipment support technician at Lakewood University. A professor reported a broken projector and you need to create a formal support ticket, CC'ing relevant stakeholders.

Create a new email conversation in FreeScout with the following details:

- **Mailbox:** AV Support
- **To (Customer):** prof.martinez@lakewood-univ.edu
- **CC:** deptchair.wilson@lakewood-univ.edu, facilities@lakewood-univ.edu
- **Subject:** Projector Maintenance Request - Room 301 Anderson Hall
- **Body:**

Dear Prof. Martinez,

We have received your report about the malfunctioning Epson projector in Room 301, Anderson Hall. Our technician team has scheduled an on-site inspection for Thursday between 10 AM and 12 PM to assess the HDMI input failure and color calibration issues.

A portable projector has been reserved for your Wednesday lecture. Please contact ext. 4521 to arrange pickup.

Best regards,
AV Support Team

**Important notes:**
- The CC field may be hidden by default. Look for a 'CC' link or button near the TO/recipient field to reveal it.
- The customer prof.martinez@lakewood-univ.edu already exists in the system.
- The 'AV Support' mailbox already exists.
- After composing the message with all fields filled in, click Send.
